activation_rule: Only a refs/heads/main commit containing the exact genuine fitted artifact bytes, verified reconstructed source manifest/snapshots, predictive/acquisition code manifests, completed frozen model-selection record, and matching non-null hashes may change status to FROZEN. Feature branches never activate a freeze or evidence clock.
notes: artifact_sha256 is the model artifact's canonical internal identity; artifact_file_sha256 separately binds exact committed JSON bytes.

The current SportsDataverse historical-release assets are reconstructed historical inputs, not historical PIT evidence, and must never be relabelled PRE_EVENT_ARCHIVE or EVENT_TIMESTAMPED_REPLAY without independent timestamp proof.

RECONSTRUCTED_HISTORICAL_NOT_PIT training is permitted only when feature construction matches the live serving distribution: week 2+ metrics through game.week-1 and week 1 explicit prior-season fallback under AS_OF_WEEK_MATCHED_V1.

The preferred reconstructed advanced-stat source is the same CFBD /stats/season/advanced endpoint and live query semantics used by serving, replayed historically with endWeek. Full-season aggregates and independently reimplemented PPA/advanced-stat formulas may not substitute for that source contract.

CFBD PPA and related model-derived advanced metrics do not expose a bindable model-version field in the advanced-stat contract. Historical replay therefore records provider metric vintage as UNKNOWN_CURRENT_PROVIDER_VINTAGE and makes no claim that a past-season value reflects the model vintage that existed in that season.

Because current-provider metric vintage may incorporate later information, historical holdout absolute score levels are engineering/model-selection diagnostics rather than unbiased historical generalization evidence. Shared provider-vintage contamination does not prove candidate ranking is unbiased.
A frozen artifact under this registry grants no promotion authority and no historical validation claim; forward evidence must begin prospectively under the active promotion evidence policy.
Synthetic fixture artifacts and CI determinism fixtures are prohibited as freeze evidence.
Runtime must fail closed while status is UNFROZEN.
